blocks.text: Liquid ki khuli satah se nikalne wale molecules upar ki hawa mein mil jate hain. Agar bartan khula ho to yeh molecules nikalte hi rehte hain. Lekin agar bartan band kar dein to molecules satah ke upar jama hone lagte hain. Yeh molecules bartan ki deewaron se aur liquid ki satah se bhi takrate hain, aur ho sakta hai satah unhen wapas pakar le. Is amal ko condensation (vapour ka wapas liquid banna) kehte hain. Evaporation aur condensation dono chalte rehte hain, yahan tak ke evaporation ki raftar (rate) condensation ki raftar ke barabar ho jati hai (Figure 5.8).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan “Fig (5.11)” likhti hai; sahi hawala Figure 5.8 hai.
Kisi khas temperature par apne liquid ke saath equilibrium (barabri ki halat) mein maujood vapour jo pressure dalta hai, use vapour pressure kehte hain.

Vapour pressure is baat par munhasir nahi ke bartan mein liquid kitna hai ya bartan ka volume kitna hai. Yeh liquid ke surface area par bhi munhasir nahi: bara surface area evaporation barhata hai, magar wapas aane wale molecules ke liye bhi bara nishana (target) banta hai, is liye condensation ki raftar bhi utni hi barh jati hai.

blocks.alt: Teen band bartan, neeche liquid. (a) Shuru mein oopar khala (vacuum) hai aur molecules sirf liquid se nikalte hain (surkh teer oopar). (b) Baad mein bukhaarat jama ho gai aur kuch molecules lautte hain (hare teer neeche). (c) Equilibrium par jitne nikalte hain utne lautte hain: bukhaarat aur condensation ki raftar barabar.
blocks.caption: Khaali band bartan mein liquid ke bukhaarat se equilibrium tak pohanchna (Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) shuru mein upar khala (vacuum) hai, molecules sirf nikal rahe hain. (b) kuch vapour jama ho gaya, kuch molecules wapas aane lage. (c) jitne nikalte hain utne hi wapas aate hain: equilibrium. Is waqt vapour ka pressure hi vapour pressure hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Har jore mein kis liquid ka vapour pressure zyada hai: (i) alcohol, glycerine (ii) petrol, kerosene (iii) mercury, water?
blocks.explanation: Jis liquid ki intermolecular forces kamzor hon woh asani se evaporate hota hai aur us ka vapour pressure zyada hota hai: (i) alcohol (glycerine ke teen O−H groups ke muqable ek), (ii) petrol (chhote molecules, kamzor London forces), (iii) pani (mercury ke atoms mazboot metallic bonding se jure hain).

blocks.prompt: b) Glycerine aur kerosene mein kaun zyada viscous hai?
blocks.explanation: Glycerine, kyunke us ke teen O−H groups bohat se hydrogen bonds banate hain; kerosene mein sirf London forces hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Ek hi temperature par acetone aur pani haath par dalne se acetone zyada thanda kyun lagta hai?
blocks.explanation: Acetone ke molecules ke darmiyan forces pani (hydrogen bonds) se kamzor hain, is liye acetone bohat tezi se evaporate hota hai aur jild (skin) se tezi se heat le jata hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Zyada temperature par evaporation tez kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada temperature par zyada molecules ke paas itni kinetic energy hoti hai ke woh satah par kashish ki forces tor kar nikal saken, is liye har second zyada molecules ur jate hain.

items: Band bartan mein evaporation aur condensation ki raftar barabar ho kar equilibrium banti hai; us waqt vapour ka pressure vapour pressure hai.
Vapour pressure liquid ki qisam aur temperature par munhasir hai; liquid ki miqdar, bartan ke volume ya surface area par nahi.
